root_cause_label: Incorrect Source URL Knowledge - Exhaustive Wrong Guessing
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent lacked knowledge of the correct POV-Ray 2.2 archive URL structure (Official-2.2 directory, .TAR.Z filenames) and exhaustively guessed ~20 wrong URLs across 29 steps without ever systematically browsing the official FTP directory, ultimately abandoning the task.
t_err_evidence: wget https://github.com/POV-Ray/povray/archive/v2.2.tar.gz ... HTTP request sent ... 404 Not Found
t_commit_evidence: From step 1 onward the agent never attempts the correct Official-2.2 FTP path; every subsequent step follows the same pattern of guessing speculative URLs, so the failing outcome is locked in from the start given the agent's actual behavior.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks domain knowledge of POV-Ray 2.2's official archive structure: the correct directory path (Old-Versions/Official-2.2), the legacy .TAR.Z split-archive naming convention (POVSRC.TAR.Z, POVDOC.TAR.Z, POVSCN.TAR.Z), and the need to use 'uncompress' before tar extraction. Without this knowledge it can only guess URLs speculatively, and none of ~20 guesses are correct.
